# JJ Solutions Lab

> JJ Solutions Lab is a founder-led technology company providing AI, data, software engineering, DevOps, cloud, IoT, automation, business intelligence, and process-improvement solutions.

## Official website

- [Home](https://jjsolutions-lab.github.io/): Company overview, services, technology capabilities, process, and founder information.
- [About](https://jjsolutions-lab.github.io/about-us/): Company values, delivery approach, and founder profile.
- [Products](https://jjsolutions-lab.github.io/products/): Business software products developed by JJ Solutions Lab.
- [Internship](https://jjsolutions-lab.github.io/internship/): Practical internship tracks in software, data, AI, cloud, and DevOps.
- [Certificate verification](https://jjsolutions-lab.github.io/verify-certificate/): Official internship certificate verification.
- [Contact](https://jjsolutions-lab.github.io/contact-us/): Official business contact details and inquiry form.

## Core capabilities

- Data science and machine learning
- Root cause analysis consulting
- Causal AI integration
- Database development
- Business intelligence and analytics
- Process intelligence and operational excellence
- DevOps, cloud, DataOps, and data engineering
- IoT solutions and custom business software
